C-QUICKLOOK-CONTENT-BOUNDARY.IntentSummary: Keep untrusted QuickLook Markdown in a data boundary, block document-controlled execution/network/navigation, and prove the actual native provider through an isolated fixture and a blocking CI dependency. Main Mark rendering, production signing and installed extensions are outside scope.
C-QUICKLOOK-CONTENT-BOUNDARY.ReferenceState: Prepared on main b77669f59fde849e4de08a5d4552126515618dfc after native editor PR #223. The specification is explicitly approved. Baseline renderer/provider are unchanged; standalone extension is not currently routed as a module. M-073/V-M-073 are unused and proposed for this ownership.
C-QUICKLOOK-CONTENT-BOUNDARY.Architecture: Keep the packaged markdown-it/highlight scripts and current typography options, but set raw HTML false. Embed document text as UTF-8 base64 data, never raw executable source; decode inside the trusted nonce-bearing bootstrap. Keep escaped titles. Emit CSP before content: default-src none, only per-render nonce-bearing packaged scripts, trusted inline styles, embedded raster data images, no network/connect/frame/object/form/base resources. No unsafe-eval, remote fallback, sanitizer dependency or main-app renderer change is introduced. Native WKWebView configuration uses a nonpersistent data store, disables automatic windows, and installs the actual provider as navigation/UI delegate. Permit the explicitly initiated native preview load; refuse external main/subframe navigation and return no new window. No NSWorkspace external open is added. Remove only the preview network-client entitlement; sandbox and selected-file read entitlement remain.
C-QUICKLOOK-CONTENT-BOUNDARY.LocalResourcePolicy: Packaged JavaScript/CSS and embedded raster data images remain supported. The current provider loads with baseURL nil; this repair does not add a directory reader, custom URL scheme, filesystem bridge or remote image transport. Explicit file URLs and remote resources are refused. Capture baseline behavior for harmless relative/absolute local images before policy writes. If an existing authorized local resource actually works and the proposed policy would remove it, stop for a bounded policy adjustment rather than hiding the regression. The owner sees this local-resource limitation when reviewing the completed plan.
C-QUICKLOOK-CONTENT-BOUNDARY.NativeFixture: tools/check-quicklook.mjs uses Node built-ins, an owned temporary directory under .claude/quicklook-content-boundary and a loopback-only observer bound to 127.0.0.1 on an ephemeral port. Compile the actual MarkdownRenderer.swift and PreviewProvider.swift plus tests/quicklook/PreviewBoundaryTests.swift with xcrun swiftc, Swift 5 language mode and Cocoa/QuickLookUI/WebKit frameworks. The generated fixture bundle has its own com.xronocode.mark.quicklook.fixture identifier; copy packaged resources unchanged and record their digests. Execute its exact binary directly with activation prohibited, not open/pluginkit/lsregister. No production extension is installed or registered. The real provider/delegates remain in use; the fixture must not substitute a permissive webview/delegate or a rewritten renderer.
C-QUICKLOOK-CONTENT-BOUNDARY.FixtureCases: Require all 24 named cases: markdown highlight unicode-title embedded-raster raw-event-handler raw-script script-terminator mixed-case-terminator svg-handler iframe-srcdoc object-embed form javascript-link data-svg remote-image fetch-beacon external-navigation new-window subframe initial-load missing-file resource-integrity file-resource-policy repeat-preview. Positive cases assert literal text, headings/table, Unicode/title escaping, syntax-highlight spans and a decoded embedded raster image. Negative payloads use harmless in-memory markers and the owned loopback observer, never external data or destinations. Assert no marker execution, active raw element, network request, extra window or unauthorized navigation. Exercise actual external-link activation/new-window/subframe decisions independently of raw HTML stripping. Missing-file completion must report error. Repeat preview on one provider must display only the new fixture. Capture baseline file-image behavior and stop if the proposed policy contradicts a proved supported local case.
C-QUICKLOOK-CONTENT-BOUNDARY.RunnerContract: A non-macOS host, missing compiler/resource, compiler failure, malformed native JSON, missing/duplicate case, failed case, observer request or deadline expiry is a nonzero failure, never a successful skip. Validate the complete expected case-ID set and results before emitting BLOCK_QUICKLOOK_BOUNDARY_CONFIRMED. Record source revision/digests, fixture bundle/binary identity, OS/architecture and full case results. Bound the whole run to 110 seconds, including compilation and body/result collection; terminate only owned child processes and close the owned observer in finally. Unit tests inject process/host results to prove fail-closed orchestration; these doubles are not native security evidence.
C-QUICKLOOK-CONTENT-BOUNDARY.WorkflowIntegration: Add quicklook-native to the existing test workflow on macos-15 with a five-minute job budget, existing immutable checkout/setup-node pins and Node 22, contents-read permissions and no signing/release credentials. Use the same changes/docs_only condition as current heavy jobs; every runtime path is already selected by the fail-closed non-docs filter. Run the actual native fixture and the extension-only unsigned build. Add quicklook-native to status-check needs and both aggregate branches: non-docs requires success; docs-only permits only success/skipped. Execute the actual rendered aggregate shell in controlled tests to prove native failure/cancellation cannot become a green required status, including the docs-only branch. Do not change branch rulesets or existing suite timeouts/retries/floors.
C-QUICKLOOK-CONTENT-BOUNDARY.UnsignedBuild: Build only scheme MarkPreview with xcodebuild -project mark-quicklook/MarkQuickLook.xcodeproj -scheme MarkPreview -configuration Debug -derivedDataPath .claude/quicklook-content-boundary/derived CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY= REGISTER_APP_WITH_LAUNCH_SERVICES=NO SKIP_INSTALL=YES build. This exact extension-only form was checked on the baseline and has no RegisterWithLaunchServices step. Do not build/register the host application, change signing identities, run pluginkit, install the extension or replace the owner app. Verify logs and owned outputs; packaging is not owner acceptance.
C-QUICKLOOK-CONTENT-BOUNDARY.CommandBudgets: Baseline unsigned host build took 30.38 seconds; the later extension-only unsigned build passed without a LaunchServices step. The unchanged release-github-controls suite passed 24 tests in 1.83 seconds, wall 3.93 seconds. The native fixture does not exist yet; its 120-second gate and 110-second runner limit include compile plus 24 bounded cases. Focused orchestration/aggregate tests have a 30-second gate. Measure actual post-implementation runtime; an over-budget or unsupported native host requires a bounded replan, not a silently longer timeout or a green skip. Extension packaging and hosted startup remain in acceptance.
C-QUICKLOOK-CONTENT-BOUNDARY.Coordination: Execute sequentially with one writer. M-046 also belongs to the release-action-reference change; integrate/reconcile that known sibling state before writing its shared projection or supersede if assertions conflict. C-50 and the Export change remain outside this observed scope. New M-073/V-M-073 entries belong in routed features documents, with index registration; Swift compiler/native evidence is primary and no unavailable Swift semantic-map analysis may be claimed as parser-proven.

T-001.Title: Establish failing-first native evidence and repair the content/navigation boundary

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Implement the fixture and fail-closed runner first. Run the unchanged actual provider/renderer: harmless HTML execution or remote-resource cases must fail the same negative oracles used after repair. Preserve the full failed receipt. Also record ordinary Markdown/highlighting/Unicode/embedded-resource and local-image baseline outcomes before policy writes.

Apply only the renderer data/CSP/HTML policy, native configuration/delegates and preview-entitlement changes described above. Add synchronized file-local contracts/maps/change summaries. Preserve packaged resource bytes, ordinary Markdown typography, selected-file reading and existing completion behavior.

Run all 24 actual native cases with independent observer counts and resource/binary identities. No marker executes and no observer request arrives. Positive rendering/highlighting/embedded-raster cases and repeat preview remain correct. Do not substitute browser emulation, static string tests, a permissive test provider, a changed oracle or absent-case success for native proof.

Test runner failure paths using injected compiler/process/host results on all supported unit-test hosts. A native failure, empty result, missing case, observer error or timeout cannot emit the confirmation marker. Owned child/observer cleanup is unconditional.

Update only M-046/V-M-046 for the additional test job/aggregate. Do not mutate frozen archives, current context or unrelated module metadata to make lint green.
